stories.title: Trap modal focus and return it to the trigger
stories.scope: platform/ui/app.js — openModal(): store the opener in state.modalReturnFocus (document.activeElement) and move focus onto el.btnCloseModal after unhiding; the existing window keydown handler gains a Tab/Shift+Tab trap cycling focusables inside el.inspectorModal (e.key === "Tab"); closeModal(): restore focus to state.modalReturnFocus when it is still in the document, then clear it. Escape, backdrop click, `close` and the one-level-deep single modal shell are preserved. Pin these wiring names for the check: state.modalReturnFocus, el.btnCloseModal.focus().
stories.acceptance: Open the diff or merge modal by keyboard: focus moves into the dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the modal only. Escape, backdrop click, and `close` each close it and return focus to the exact control that opened it; a second modal never stacks.

stories.title: Verify click-first, hover parity, and document-order tab order
stories.scope: Evidence audit over platform/ui/index.html + app.js + styles.css: no positive tabindex; native interactive controls enumerating in document order; exactly one keydown listener (the modal Escape/Tab handler — no custom shortcuts beyond Tab/Enter/Space/Escape); no drag/contextmenu handlers; no window.confirm/alert (inline confirm replaces dialogs); no control hidden behind hover (display:none only for [hidden] and scrollbars). Built behavior — prove, do not rebuild.
stories.acceptance: The audit passes and prints the control inventory as evidence; any custom shortcut, browser dialog, positive tabindex, or hover-only action fails it.
stories.check_cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const html=fs.readFileSync("platform/ui/index.html","utf8");const app=fs.readFileSync("platform/ui/app.js","utf8");const css=fs.readFileSync("platform/ui/styles.css","utf8");for(const [f,s] of [["index.html",html],["app.js",app]]){const pos=[...s.matchAll(/tabindex\s*=\s*"(\d+)"/g)].map(m=>Number(m[1])).filter(n=>n>0);if(pos.length)throw new Error(f+": positive tabindex values "+pos.join(","))}const controls=[...html.matchAll(/<(button|a|input)\b[^>]*>/g)].map(m=>m[0]);if(controls.length<7)throw new Error("expected the static controls in document order; found "+controls.length);const hidden=[...css.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^}]*)\}/g)].filter(p=>/display:\s*none|visibility:\s*hidden/.test(p[2])&&!/\[hidden\]|scrollbar/.test(p[1]));if(hidden.length)throw new Error("controls hidden without hover alternatives: "+hidden.map(p=>p[1].trim()).join(" | "));const kd=(app.match(/addEventListener\("keydown"/g)||[]).length;if(kd!==1)throw new Error("expected exactly one keydown listener (modal Escape/Tab trap); got "+kd);if(/addEventListener\("contextmenu"|addEventListener\("dragstart"|window\.confirm\(|window\.alert\(/.test(app+html))throw new Error("custom shortcuts/dialogs beyond the click-first model found");console.log("OK: document-order controls, no positive tabindex, no hover-only actions")'
stories.notes: FR-8 (click-first, inline confirm, Escape — built) is verified in E1-verify; this story closes UX-DR-5's unique clauses (hover never the only path, document-order tab order). The modal trap/return delta is built by E1-impl-modal-focus-management.
